<action type="say">
Yes, I can set that up.

I’ll need a few details first so I can request accurate quotes:

1) Address: What’s the full address where the work will be done (city/ZIP at minimum)?
2) Timing:
   - How urgent is this? (emergency / same day / routine)
   - Any preferred date?
   - Preferred time window? (morning, afternoon, evening, or a specific range like 9–12)
3) Faucet details:
   - Do you already have the new faucet, or do you want the plumber to supply it?
   - Type of faucet if you know it (single-handle, pull-down sprayer, etc.) and whether it’s replacing an existing faucet in the same spot.
   - Any known issues with existing shutoff valves or supply lines, or is this a straightforward swap?
4) Access/notes: Any special access notes (gated building, parking issues, etc.)?

Once you share these, I’ll request quotes from multiple local plumbers and show you the options.</action>
